LongDescription: The ACI Pure Shahi Haleem Mix offers a quick and easy way to prepare the traditional and flavorful Haleem, a rich and wholesome dish enjoyed across cultures. This mix combines high-quality ingredients to deliver authentic taste and texture without the hassle of lengthy preparation.rnrnIngredients:rnWheatrnLentils (Split Bengal gram, Red lentils, and others)rnSpices (Coriander, Turmeric, Cumin, Cinnamon, Cloves, and more)rnSaltrnGhee (Clarified Butter)rnFlavor Enhancersrn(Note: Exact proportions are listed on the package.)rnrnMaking ProcessrnrnPreparation:rnBoil your choice of meat (chicken, beef, or mutton) until tender.rnShred the meat and set it aside.rnrnCooking:rnIn a large pot, mix the ACI Pure Shahi Haleem Mix with water to form a smooth consistency.rnAdd the shredded meat to the mixture and stir thoroughly.rnSimmer on low heat, stirring occasionally, until the dish thickens to your desired consistency.rnrnServing:rnGarnish with fried onions, lemon wedges, green chilies, and fresh coriander before serving.rn(Complete cooking instructions are on the package.)rnrnBrand : ACI PurernPack Size : 200 gm
